title: E-LINK EL-304GP 4-Port Gigabit with 1.25G SFP Uplink PoE Network Switch

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
E-LINK EL-304GP 4-Port PoE+ Switch with 1 Uplink and 1 SFP Fiber Port

The E-LINK EL-304GP is a high-performance 4-Port Gigabit PoE+ Networking Switch equipped with 1 Fast Ethernet uplink port and 1 SFP 1.25Gbps fiber port. Designed for small to medium networks, it provides both power and data over a single Ethernet cable, making it ideal for powering IP cameras, wireless APs, and VoIP phones.


Key Features

  • 4 × PoE+ Ports – Supports IEEE 802.3af/at, delivering up to 30W per port
  • 1 × Fast Ethernet Uplink Port – Ensures stable connectivity to core networks
  • 1 × 1.25Gbps SFP Fiber Uplink Port – Supports long-distance fiber transmission
  • PoE Power Budget: Up to 78W total
  • Data Transmission: 100m in standard mode, 250m in extended PoE mode
  • Switching Capacity: 12Gbps with 2K MAC address table
  • Surge Protection: Built-in lightning and ESD protection for reliable performance
  • VLAN Support: Port isolation via DIP switch for enhanced network security
  • Unmanaged Plug-and-Play: Easy installation, no configuration required
